descriptionChirho: Active threshing of grain or crops, the agricultural process of separating kernels from husks; consistently rendered as eng 'thresh/threshing', spa 'trillar', hin 'दाँवना/दावना', arb 'دَوْس' (daws), kor '타작하다' (tajak-hada), swa 'kupura' across all six languages

To trample or tread upon, often metaphorical or judgmental trampling of people or lands; distinguished by different vocabulary in multiple languages: eng 'trample/trampled', spa 'pisotear/trillar' (passive), hin 'रौंदना' (raundna) vs 'दाँवना', arb 'يُدَاسُ' (passive daws), kor '밟다' (balpda = tread/step on) vs '타작' (thresh), swa 'kukanyagwa' (be trampled) vs 'kupura' (thresh)
